[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Feasibility Analysis: Assessing technological, financial, and operational feasibility of the idea.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Concept Development: Creating an initial design or prototype, identifying the target audience, and understanding their needs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Testing: Gathering feedback from a small group of customers to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement.
